statement: A dispute opened from any Account state the book produced pays each side what both signed: the moved offdeltas, plus (when the taker fills the open clauses in full) exactly the lots still open at the owners' own prices. The Arrival cell holds one Account of two parties: a dispute from any reachable state pays the moved offdeltas plus the taker's ratio of what the clauses still hold (killed by a dispute that forgets the filled part, and by a stale clause); hub lots, prices and dust are on no spec page.
source: Hub matching engine review B (PR 92), on Arthur's 10-01 02:53 swap decision (a dispute honors what was filled) and plan/swap-onchain.md
